description: Interface state, throughput, errors, and inventory from ethtool_exporter.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Exporter targets that failed their last scrape.

panels.title: Scrape errors
panels.description: Exporters that could not enumerate /sys/class/net on their last scrape.

panels.title: Interfaces not up
panels.description: Operstate is not "up". Includes administratively down and unused ports, and virtual devices that report "unknown".

panels.title: Carrier changes
panels.description: Carrier up/down transitions over the selected time range.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Receive above zero, transmit below. From /sys/class/net/<dev>/statistics.

panels.title: Utilization
panels.description: max(rx, tx) bits/s divided by negotiated speed. Interfaces with unknown speed (most virtual devices) are omitted.

targets.expr: max without (stat) (rate(ethtool_interface_stat{stat=~"rx_bytes|tx_bytes", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8 / (ethtool_interface_speed_mbps{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"} * 1e6 > 0)

topk(10, max without (stat) (rate(ethtool_interface_stat{stat=~"rx_bytes|tx_bytes", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8 / (ethtool_interface_speed_mbps{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"} * 1e6 > 0))

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Non-zero error counters from sysfs statistics (CRC, frame, FIFO, missed, carrier, ...).

panels.title: Drops
panels.description: rx_dropped often counts frames for protocols nothing on the host consumes (for example LLDP without lldpd). Compare with rx_nohandler and NIC driver counters before treating it as loss.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance, device, address, operstate, duplex, ifalias) (ethtool_interface_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_interface_speed_mbps{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_interface_mtu_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device, driver, firmware_version) (ethtool_driver_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
sum by (job, instance, device) (rate(ethtool_interface_stat{stat="rx_bytes", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8
sum by (job, instance, device) (rate(ethtool_interface_stat{stat="tx_bytes", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8

panels.title: NIC hardware
panels.description: PCI identity from sysfs, driver/firmware from ETHTOOL_GDRVINFO, queue counts, and SR-IOV VFs.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance, device, vendor, device_id, numa_node) (ethtool_device_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device, version, firmware_version, bus_info) (ethtool_driver_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_queue_count{direction="rx", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_queue_count{direction="tx", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_device_sriov_numvfs{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description: Keep total well under scrape_timeout. Disable expensive collectors if it grows.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance, version, goversion) (ethtool_exporter_build_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})
